shots.caption: Three helmeted Guardians move in a low crouch-run through a dim, teal-lit Vex ruin corridor, weapons raised and ready.
An armored Guardian's back fills the foreground while two more Guardians aim their weapons down a rubble-strewn stairwell in the ruins beyond.
Two Guardians push forward side by side through the ruins, one in heavy plate armor aiming a rifle, the other in a flowing cloak raised behind cover.
A hooded Guardian leaps into the air with void energy blazing around a raised fist as a Vex Minotaur aims its weapon in response.
A sprawling firefight spans a shattered Vex courtyard as Guardians perched on broken pillars trade beam fire with a crowd of machines below while an arc blast tears through the center.
A chaotic firefight fills the frame: a Vex Minotaur anchors a crowd of machines on the left while Guardians leap, fall, and fire through crossing beams of light on the right.
A hooded Guardian braces atop a jagged black Vex spire and fires a rifle through drifting embers, a bright muzzle flash cutting across crossing pink hard-light beams.
A dark-haired Awoken pilot screams in a cockpit harness, amber eyes wide, red-lit machinery close behind his head.
A cloaked Guardian looks out from a ledge over a vast ruined facility shrouded in teal fog.
Two armored figures walk a raised catwalk inside a blue-lit industrial facility.
Two Guardians walk in silhouette down a corridor toward a bright exit.
A small group of Guardians gathers near a vehicle deep inside an icy cave.
Three Guardians advance in silhouette down a warmly lit interior hall.
A fireteam of three Guardians advances with weapons drawn across icy terrain.
A lone Guardian stands centered in a grand, symmetrical hall bathed in red light, weapon in hand.
Two Guardians leap through a narrow icy chasm opening toward bright light beyond.
A robed figure stands alone on a ridge, facing a distant brilliant light.
A Guardian stands within a glowing orange energy dome as particles radiate outward.
Extreme close-up on a Guardian's armored shoulder and helmet, lit red with sparks drifting past.
Extreme close-up of a Titan firing a weapon directly at camera, muzzle flash blooming bright.
A bright energy beam weapon fires down a futuristic corridor between two distant silhouetted combatants.
A Guardian runs and leaps across a red-lit metal scaffold.
Two Guardians stand in silhouette against a bright starburst of light.
Extreme close-up of a Guardian in gold armor firing a shotgun, muzzle flash and snow bursting outward.
Extreme close-up on a Guardian's boots walking across reflective pink-lit ground.
A Guardian runs in silhouette across an icy ridge beneath a huge distant planet.
A Guardian clashes with a dark enemy amid a burst of blue Stasis crystals.
Two Guardians sprint through a facility corridor firing red energy weapons at unseen enemies.
Two armored Guardians crouch together in cover against a blue-lit technological backdrop.
An armored figure stands amid falling ice shards in a blue-lit scene.
A hooded figure raises a crackling ice-blue Stasis blade toward the camera in dramatic red light.
Two combatants clash in a burst of crackling blue-white energy.
A Guardian raises a weapon amid a bright explosion as another figure looks on nearby.
A silhouetted Guardian stands amid drifting embers beside a bright orb of light.
Several silhouetted combatants clash amid a burst of icy blue light.
A robed figure stands with their back to camera inside a round, blue-lit chamber.
A hooded figure in a fur-trimmed coat and breathing mask holds up a lit torch inside a dim, cluttered structure.
Seen from behind, a lone figure stands in the snow watching a large wreck burn nearby.
A hooded figure in a fur-trimmed coat and breathing mask raises a lit torch, an 'S'-marked pendant hanging at his chest.
Seen from behind, a cloaked figure walks away across the ice toward a bright sun with Jupiter overhead.
A helmeted rider leans low over a sparrow racing across the icy ground, motion-blurred with speed.
Two riders race sparrows side by side through a narrow, fog-filled ice canyon.
The same hooded, masked figure adjusts his hood in a doorway lit by warm interior lights and a red wall panel.
A hooded rider with glowing white eyes leans into a sparrow racing through an ice canyon marked with red streaks.
Framed through a spacecraft's open cargo doors, a figure leaps down onto the snow below.
The hooded, masked figure stands before a parked dropship, looking directly ahead through blowing snow.
A motion-blurred close-up of the hooded, masked figure raising a gloved hand toward his face.
A cloaked, helmeted figure strides across the ice with a small light hovering alongside, twin moons overhead.
Three tiny figures stand apart on a wide, sunlit expanse of rippled snow and sand.
Three armored figures stand together on the ice, weapons slung, facing outward in different directions.
Three cloaked figures stand close together as a small winged companion drone hovers beside them.
Three armored figures stand together on the ice, one carrying a large weapon across their back.
Three small figures walk together across a fogbound icefield toward a massive dark pyramid on the horizon.
A row of armored Guardians and allies stand together on an elevated walkway inside a high-tech interior.
Seen from behind a pilot's seat, a ship banks past a fiery orbital debris trail toward a distant world.
A Guardian leaps through the air in silhouette, a dark ribbon-like effect trailing overhead against purple light.
A Guardian crouches with a weapon beside fallen enemies in a rain-slick Neomuna alley.
Two silhouetted figures clash in combat, one wielding a staff and the other a large curved blade, against the glowing Neomuna skyline.
Seen from above, a robed figure leaps through the air over fallen chrome-armored bodies.
A caped, helmeted Guardian is engulfed in a bright solar explosion mid-battle.
Two matching robed figures perform a symmetrical fire-lighting ritual facing each other in a dim hall.
A squad of hooded Guardians walk in silhouette toward camera, backlit by the glowing Neomuna skyline.
A Guardian crackling with violet void energy battles a large gold mechanical Vex construct.
A Guardian's armor erupts with void energy beside a towering gold Vex construct.
An overexposed shot of a Guardian mid-air wreathed in bright energy above a neon-lit city.
A Guardian wrapped in bright green Strand energy flies with arms outstretched against a fiery orange backdrop.
Guardians wreathed in green Strand energy clash with gold-armored Vex constructs in a chaotic battle.
Two green, Strand-wreathed Guardians charge into battle against gold-armored Vex constructs and a shielded Vex unit in a neon-lit street.
A Guardian is thrown backward in a burst of green energy as a robed figure looks on at the frame's edge.
A Guardian in teal armor aims a weapon as another Guardian's silhouette is visible at the frame's edge.
A group of armored figures descend stairs together, the whole scene bathed in red light.
Tracking shot down a crowded Last City market street, a Guardian walking away from camera through civilians. Warm, lived-in. Burned-in 'Not Actual Gameplay' disclaimer.
Low shot of armored Titan boots planted on grey lunar rock, mountains beyond. Anonymous, monumental.
Over-the-shoulder on two helmeted Guardians in a dim briefing space, teal light.
A helmeted Guardian sits amid crew in a dim hold, framed between two foreground figures.
A ring of Guardians resting on crates and rock in low red light — the quiet before.
A Hunter in a hooded helm with a green visor stands still against teal haze. Fully anonymous, fully iconic.
A lone Guardian silhouetted at the center of an enormous violet detonation, debris hanging in the shockwave.
A Guardian stands on a ridge in pale cloud, facing a distant black pyramid. Small figure, huge sky.
Two Guardians advance shoulder to shoulder with rifles raised, drenched in red light.
A lone cloaked figure walks out across an enormous grey-green plain under storm cloud. Pure scale.
Guardians move up through red-lit ruins in loose formation, dust in the air.
A helmeted Guardian stands over a shrouded body laid out on pale cloth. Blue, still, funerary.
A single red-armored Guardian walks alone through violet fog, tiny against the dark.
A helmeted Guardian pushes into blinding white light, lens flares streaking across frame.
A Guardian swings a blade mid-charge as allies close in, violet and fire light colliding.
Guardians charge through smoke, motion-blurred, weapons up.
Overhead wide: a Guardian at the center of an arc detonation, blue lightning branching across the ground.
A Guardian drives a blade forward through a wall of fire, face lit gold by the blast.
A hooded Hunter raises a crackling arc weapon overhead against a night sky. Anonymous and heroic.
A Guardian hurls a torrent of blue-white energy across a dark field, hands trailing light.
A hooded Guardian turns through drifting embers, orange firelight raking the helmet.
A Warlock draws violet and white prismatic light up into both hands, face lit from below.
A Hunter with a teeth-patterned helmet aims a long rifle across a misty swamp as a second Guardian wades through the water beyond.
Three Guardians spread across a misty swamp aim their weapons outward past clusters of red Hive flora.
A Guardian raises both hands as a bright light gathers between their palms, a hazy cityscape glowing behind them.
A cloaked figure carrying a glowing curved sword advances down a symmetrical, ice-blue corridor.
A lone silhouette walks toward a bright archway deep within a rocky, teal-lit tunnel.
A first-person view of a weapon-in-hand advancing down a dark, green-lit passage toward a carved wall.
A first-person view down a weapon toward a green-lit altar as two silhouetted figures stand before it in a grand hall.
Three silhouetted Guardians race down a spired, magenta-lit corridor, one wielding a drawn sword.
Two Guardians aim their weapons up a grand ice-blue staircase toward an unseen threat.
Three masked Hunters stand together in a warmly lit, ornate hall, the center Guardian holding a rifle raised.
Motion-blurred legs of several running and leaping figures cross a narrow bridge above a misty green chasm.
A Guardian leaps sword-first through a blinding burst of energy as a caped figure and a crystalline creature clash beside them.
A robed Guardian is wreathed in searing red-orange light as bright tracer fire streaks past overhead.
A weapon blurs past in the foreground as a glowing Guardian and a spiked Hive creature clash beyond.
A Guardian silhouette leaps sword-raised through a blinding wash of orange solar light.
A Hunter braces and aims an ornate weapon through drifting smoke as a burning Hive enemy collapses nearby.
A Guardian is engulfed in crackling blue-white arc energy against a bright open sky.
A caped figure bursts through a wall of magenta energy, blade raised, as another combatant closes in beside them.
A caped figure surges through a bright magenta blast, sword drawn, amid a shower of crystalline debris.
Three Hunters take up firing positions in an ornate hall lined with red Hive flora.
A first-person view down a rifle as a horde of Hive Thrall charges across a grand hall.
A first-person view down a shotgun as several Hive creatures collapse across the hall floor.
A Hunter leaps through a burst of violet energy, a trail of fire streaming from their cloak below.
A cloaked Guardian swings a blazing blade downward before a grand archway as a burning enemy falls nearby.
